changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7719-app-menu-item-shortcut-named-refusal.md`

- names `LayoutRenderer.tsx` → `packages/runner/src/LayoutRenderer.tsx` — edited by this change

  > ⛔ `LayoutRenderer` 未恢复任何读点，`adb2a86db` 的那枚 pin 断言原样保留；本次只修了它与 `LayoutRenderer.tsx` 里已经过期的散文（两处都在把一个已裁决的问题描述成悬而未决）。 `@object-ui/runner` 的改动**仅为注释**，无任何已发布行为变化。

### `.changeset/9040-record-details-top-level-spec-parity.md`

- names `record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` → `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > ⚠️ The retired `layout` on the same interface was NOT removed by this change. The contract refuses it by name (ADR-0087 D2 tombstone, removed in `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0), and it stayed a published key `tsc` accepted and publish rejected — signposted at the declaration and pinned by `record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` rather than removed, because a retirement carries its own obligations and its own FROM/TO changeset.

### `.changeset/9040-retire-record-details-layout.md`

- names `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` → `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > - `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts` wrote `layout: 'stacked'` on this interface and read it back. Both lines are gone, with the reason stated at the site and a live-key read-back put in their place so the leg is not quietly shrunk. Its `RecordHighlightsComponentProps` neighbour keeps its own `layout` — a different key on a different face. - `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts` ledgered the divergence as OPEN. Those legs become the retirement's own: a `keyof` absence assertion (with a declared key read through the identical form as its control), a `@ts-expect-error` literal, and a new source-text leg. - `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-highlights-layout-9187.test.ts` read this declaration as TEXT, using its three-value `layout` as the lit control for a two-member assertion about the sibling. That control MOVED to `RecordChatterComponentProps.position` — a three-value union the contract genuinely declares — as that file's own instruction required. It was never to be deleted outright, and it is not.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `5262f7dd3` (merge-base with origin/main): 6 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1892 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2505 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36823045243)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f82cf777bae1d806bae40d5b5d6f9386960031c1`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read, and nothing else: card objectui#11330 (body and its three comments: the spec seat's queue note `5925423200`, the claim `5925455871`, the dev report `5925773522`); PR objectui#11343 (body, 7-file list, the net diff `5262f7dd3f..f82cf777ba`, which is the merge-base with `main`, so the diff is net: +170 / -18); the check-runs on the head; the governing text (ruling objectui#10916 `5866275396`; option C as `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs`'s header states it; the card's direction as the claim adopted it); objectstack `d830d71f`'s `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts` and its changeset, read with `git show`; precedent objectui#11210.

### ① Derived judgments

**The upstream fact, verified at source.** At `d830d71f` every `retiredKey()` tombstone is typed `Tombstone` of `{ '[REMOVED] Key retired: run os validate for its migration.': never }` under `ZodOptional`, so its input type is the mark or `undefined`; `RetiredKeySchema` and `Tombstone` are module-local (not exported) and the mark is written inline on purpose, so a consumer can only match it by structure. Its parent (also `17.5.0` in `packages/spec/package.json`) returned `z.never().optional()`, input `undefined`; the `d830d71f` changeset says the same ("from `undefined` to an uninhabited mark"); objectui's `pnpm-lock.yaml` resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0`, and the dev's installed-declaration scan found 0 marks there. The two spellings the helper's docblock names are the two spellings. Right.

**(a) The helper, `packages/types/src/__tests__/retired-key-type.ts`.** Traced every branch of `IsRetiredKeyType` of X and `IsRetirementMark` of M by hand. The guards, in order: `IsAny` first (so `any` never reaches the structural match); invariant `Equal` with `undefined` (so `never`, which `[X] extends [undefined]` let through on the base pins, is refused); the `undefined` arm is required (`[undefined] extends [X]`), then the remainder after `Exclude` must be the mark: not `never`, not `any`, not keyless (`unknown`, `{}`, `object`, `null`), not a template index signature (`RemovedMarkKey extends keyof M` refuses it), not a union of keys (a second property, or a union remainder such as mark-or-string whose common keys are `never`), and finally invariant equality with the remap of its one `[REMOVED] `-prefixed key to `never` (so a mark admitting a value, or a key without the prefix, is refused). Every checked type in every conditional is wrapped or derived, so nothing distributes and the helper cannot answer `boolean`. All 15 rows resolve as written: 3 positive (`undefined`; mark-or-`undefined`; a reworded sentence under the prefix) and 12 `_Not*` negatives. A live key cannot satisfy it unless its type is exactly `undefined` or exactly mark-or-`undefined`, which no live key has; `any` cannot, by the first branch and by `Equal`'s invariance. The helper is STRICTER than the four base assertions it replaces (two of which had no `any` guard of their own). The plausible loosenings the card's "not loosened to anything" forbids are each a proof row. Right.

**(b) The four pins.** Each retired-key assertion is replaced in place, never deleted: `ariaAdmitsNoValue` (chartconfig, dashboard), `_LayoutOnTheContractFace` (record-details), `admitsNoValue` (twins), all now through the helper and all still asserting the retirement exactly, by direction, on either side of the bump. Each gains a live control row through the same helper: `titleIsLive`, `widgetsIsLive`, `_ColumnsOnTheContractFaceIsLive`, `sourceIsLive`, and each control is wired into the runtime `expect` as well. The `@ts-expect-error` legs on authored values are unchanged. The ablation arithmetic reconciles with the diff: a helper body of `true` leaves the 3 positive rows green and reddens exactly the 12 `_Not*` rows plus the 4 controls (16, plus the TS6133 on the then-unused type parameter), and pointing each assertion at its control reddens exactly that assertion line, 4 in all. Sound.

**(c) `LayoutRenderer.tsx`.** `LayoutRendererProps.app` is `AppComponentSchema` from `@object-ui/types`, which extends `Omit` of the spec's `App` over `APP_SPEC_EXCLUDED` (`name`, `label`, `description`, `navigation`, `areas`, `contextSelectors`); `version` is not withheld, so it reaches the type from the spec projection, not from `BaseSchema`'s `any` index signature (which is why the base diagnostic at `:194` showed the mark, not `any`). Spec `App.version` is `retiredKey(...)` at `d830d71f` and at its parent, retired since `17.0.0` by its own guidance text, so on `17.5.0` the member is `undefined` and the `{app.version && ...}` branch could never render; on `main` it is the mark and `v{app.version}` is a TS2322 into `ReactNode`. Deleting is the right measure, not narrowing: a `typeof` narrowing would keep a read on a key the spec refuses at parse and would assert, in source, a type the key does not have. No other `.version` read remains under `packages/runner/src` at the head. The changeset `@object-ui/runner` `patch` is true: the package is `private: false` at `17.6.0`, the key is retired and parse-refused, and the footer rendered nothing on valid metadata. The one visible change is confined to an off-spec document that the runner's `MetadataLoader` does not parse through the spec; the PR's Acceptance notes name it. Right.

**(d) File surface.** Exactly the 7 files the claim allowed. No `@objectstack/spec` pin (the `^17.0.0` / `^17.5.0` manifests are untouched), no `pnpm-lock.yaml`, no `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs`, no workflow. Option C (objectui#9860) holds as the gate's header states it. Right.

**(e) Gate verdicts on this head**, read at 2026-10-01T06:16Z: 42 check-runs, 33 success, 3 skipped, 6 in_progress. `Spec Main Shape Gate`: completed, **success**, the check-run's own conclusion, not the dev's reading. Also success: `Lint`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Test (shard 1/8)`, `Test (shard 7/8)`, `Test (shard 8/8)`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Doc Snippet Type Check`, `Bundle Analysis`. NOT CONCLUDED at that reading, named and not adopted either way: `Type Check` and `Test (shard 2/8)` through `Test (shard 6/8)`. The dev's local readings (whole repository 81/81 against spec built from objectstack `b3d7a70864a7` with `report` exit 0; pinned side type-checks clean, 56 tests) are consistent with the diff and with the gate's conclusion, but the gate's own green is the verdict this record rests on. The ruleset requires `Type Check` and `Test` too; nothing lands on this record before they conclude.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/11330-runner-retired-version-footer.md`: `@object-ui/runner` `patch`. Matches what the diff publishes: one dead internal read removed from a released package; no export, prop type, or accept set moves. The body's three claims (the key is retired on the spec's app schema, the parse refuses a value, the footer could only render nothing on valid metadata) are each verified above.
- `@object-ui/types` publishes nothing from this diff: only `src/__tests__/` files change, `tsconfig.json` excludes `**/__tests__/**` from the build, and a `git grep` at the head finds the helper imported by the four pins alone. No changeset owed; no `skip-changeset` used.
- `Clause-②: no` is right. No published type, export or accept set changes; `LayoutRendererProps.app` is unchanged; behaviour on a valid document is unchanged. The `Clause-②: yes` (minor) belongs to objectstack `d830d71f`; this PR adapts objectui to it and neither widens nor narrows anything.
- The `Changeset Claim Re-read` notice names three pending changesets that cite touched files. Read against this diff: `7719-...` describes its OWN comment-only edit to `LayoutRenderer.tsx` (a claim about that change, not a standing claim about the file); `9040-record-details-top-level-spec-parity` and `9040-retire-record-details-layout` say `layout` stays pinned by `record-details-top-level-9040.test.ts`, which remains true, now through the helper. No body needs correcting.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared; none found.
- **The only `any` in the diff** is the input of `_NotAny`, the row proving the helper refuses `any`. Judged not a breach of the claim's "no `any`": it types no value, slot or export, it tightens rather than loosens, and deleting it would delete the proof. It lands as an ESLint warning, not an error; `Lint` is green on the head.
- **No deleted assertion**: all four retired-key assertions are replaced in place (see ①b); the only deletion is the runner's dead read, which no pin or test covered.
- **No tripwire for the pin bump** (the dev's "when the pin moves" note). Accepted: unlike objectui#11210's `| 'computed'` on a published table, the helper's `undefined` arm is test-only and stays exact after the bump (a dead arm, not a loosening); the module docblock names its retirement. The carrier is the pin-bump card that first carries the mark.
- **Dev deviations**: the narrowed base reading and the whole-repository fix reading, the `--concurrency=2`, and the discarded run on `8ce0077913` are all superseded by the gate's own green on `f82cf777ba`. The objectstack-side `prepare` script writing `merge.os-regen.*` and `core.hooksPath` into the shared objectstack git config is a side effect outside this repository and this PR; noted for the seat, no action here. The sibling worktree observation (`objectui-issue-11331`) is likewise not this PR's.
- **Out of scope (f)**: `packages/types/src/app.ts`'s `AppComponentSchema` docblock says a retired key "surfaces here as an optional member typed `undefined`". True of every installed spec today (the lockfile's `17.5.0`), stale only against unreleased objectstack `main`, false once the pin carries the mark. Reach: one docblock sentence, read by no test, emitted into the package's `.d.ts`.
